recognize_zh: 皮膚切片中倍下真皮被密集、單一形態的小至中型圓形藍色細胞彌漫浸潤，細胞緊貼表皮下方且把真皮乳頭推擠成不規則輪廓，表皮本身無明顯淋巴球侵入，這種皮膚單形性浸潤可見於前 B 淋巴芽細胞淋巴瘤（常見於兒童頭頸部皮膚）。
features: Dense, diffuse, monotonous dermal infiltrate of small-to-medium round blue cells
High N:C ratio cells with scant cytoplasm; fine cytologic detail not resolvable at this power
Infiltrate abuts the epidermis and fills the papillary dermis, distorting rete ridges
No evident epidermotropism; overlying epidermis intact with orthokeratosis
Sheet-like growth replacing dermal adnexal structures in this field
describe_en: Skin biopsy at medium power shows a dense, diffuse dermal infiltrate of monotonous small-to-medium sized round blue cells with scant cytoplasm that fills the papillary and reticular dermis and presses against the undersurface of the epidermis. The overlying epidermis is intact with orthokeratosis, and no epidermotropism is seen. Nuclear chromatin detail and mitotic activity cannot be assessed at this magnification. The monotonous round cell infiltrate is compatible with cutaneous involvement by precursor B-lymphoblastic lymphoma, which requires immunohistochemistry (TdT, CD79a, PAX5, CD10, CD34) for confirmation.

ddx.dx: Cutaneous involvement by AML (leukemia cutis/myeloid sarcoma)
ddx.vs: Myeloid sarcoma cells often have more eosinophilic cytoplasm with admixed eosinophilic myelocytes and express MPO, lysozyme, or CD68 rather than TdT with B-cell markers.
Burkitt shows a starry-sky pattern with tingible-body macrophages, Ki-67 near 100%, TdT negativity, and MYC rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Other small round blue cell tumors (Ewing sarcoma, neuroblastoma, Merkel cell carcinoma)
ddx.vs: These are CD45-negative and express CD99/NKX2.2, neural markers, or CK20 dot-like keratin, whereas lymphoblastic lymphoma is TdT- and CD79a/PAX5-positive.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous B-cell lymphoma (e.g., follicle center)
ddx.vs: Mature B-cell lymphomas contain centrocytes/centroblasts with a grenz zone and are TdT-negative.
